method: External real-keyboard native Windows journey, then model visual inspection of all14 images plus full-size controls/final-boss image. No images altered in the evidence set.
observations: Pre-corruption title/world/stage menus visibly use pale town palette and the normal Bean.
Actual keyboard jump changes player position in the rendered opening stage.
Pause navigation highlights Resume, Restart and Level select; return reaches the real selection screen.
Practice visibly exposes five worlds and final boss without earning progress.
The native final boss, player art, three possession sources, objective panel and narrative caption render.
F1 controls are readable in front of the boss objective; dominant foreground text is not clipped or overwritten.
Current L4 native presentation/ending renders were also inspected; the production art/presentation source is unchanged by M1, whose only engine-input delta is a route witness assertion.
limits: Not an uncoached human playtest or physical controller test.
Not an audio listening/mix review, accessibility certification or performance benchmark.
Camera-only mechanical screenshots are not substituted for native menu/backbuffer evidence.
